title: John Deere S100 42 in 17.5 HP GAS Hydrostatic Riding Lawn Tractor
description:
Tackle your lawn with ease and efficiency using the
John Deere 42-in. Lawn Tractor
, built for reliable performance, comfort, and all-season versatility. Powered by a 17.5 HP single-cylinder engine and paired with a 42″ Edge™ Mower Deck, this mower is ideal for mowing, mulching, and bagging across flat terrain with obstacles.
Key Features:
17.5 HP John Deere Engine
Robust power for mowing, mulching, and bagging—featuring full-pressure lubrication, overhead valves, and a cast-iron cylinder liner for long engine life.
Easy, Choke-Free Starts
Electronic ignition and spring-return throttle eliminate guesswork during start-up.
42″ Edge™ Mower Deck
Designed for high-quality cutting performance and clean discharge, even at faster speeds.
Hydrostatic Transmission with Side-by-Side Pedals
Offers smooth speed and direction control, just like driving a car—ideal for maneuvering around landscaping features.
Comfort-Focused Operator Station
Wide footrest, high-back adjustable seat (11″), ergonomic controls, and anti-vibration floor mats for a smoother ride.
Spring-Assisted Deck Lift
Makes it easy to raise or lower the mower deck with minimal effort.
Durable Steel Frame
Full-length welded 12-gauge steel frame with powder-coated finish ensures long-lasting structural integrity.
Cast-Iron Front Axle
Delivers strength and durability under tough conditions without bending.
No-Tools Oil Drain Valve
Simplifies oil changes and routine maintenance.
2.4-Gallon Fuel Tank
Rear-mounted tank with center fill opening and tethered cap for spill-free refueling.
Performance & Build:
Engine:
17.5 HP, 500cc, John Deere 31R977 (M31)
Transmission:
TLT200 Hydrostatic, Rear-Wheel Drive
Forward Speed:
Up to 5.5 mph
Reverse Speed:
Up to 3.2 mph
Cutting Height:
1″ to 4″, adjustable in 0.25″ increments (13 positions)
Deck Construction:
13-gauge stamped steel
Turning Radius:
18 inches (tight for a lawn tractor)
Fuel Capacity:
2.4 gallons
Battery:
12V, 300 CCA
Tires:
Front – 15×6-6, Rear – 20×8-8
Weight:
414 lbs (without fuel)
Comfort & Convenience:
Adjustable seat with 5.5″ fore/aft travel
Cup holder and storage tray with optional cover
Easy-access ignition and controls
Bright twin incandescent headlights for visibility
Built-in hour meter for maintenance tracking
Attachment-Ready:
Equipped with
CargO Mount™ System
, making it easy to install compatible add-ons:
Snow Equipment:
44” Two-Stage Snow Blower
46” Front Blade
Weather enclosure & tire chains
Yard Tools:
Rear Bagger (6.5 bushel, sold separately)
Mulching kit
Tow-behind sprayers, spreaders, and more
Extras:
Front bumper
Sun canopy
Lawn striping kit
Bucket holder
Warranty & Support:
2-Year/120-Hour Bumper-to-Bumper Warranty
Whichever comes first—see JohnDeere.com for full terms.
Built in Greeneville, Tennessee, USA
Product Dimensions:
Length:
69.7 in
Width with Deck:
55.2 in (46.5 in with deflector raised)
Height:
40 in
Wheelbase:
48.9 in
Weight:
414 lbs (without fuel)
